design.success_rule: planning assumption selected by user: two-sided 95% Newcombe hybrid-score/Wilson risk-difference CI lower bound > 0
design.success_rule_status: exploratory planning only; formal Phase III confirmation pending

primary_endpoint.name: 治疗第90天mRS 0–1应答率
primary_endpoint.analysis_population: Phase III主分析人群待定义
primary_endpoint.treatment_contrast: Phase III治疗组和对照待锁定
primary_endpoint.effect_scale_status: current exploratory planning scale selected by user; formal Phase III confirmation pending

primary_endpoint.intercurrent_event_strategy: 死亡作为复合策略未应答；其他ICE待定义

candidate_endpoints.name: 治疗21天内缺血性卒中发生率
治疗90天内严重缺血性复合事件
治疗90天内大出血或重度出血安全性终点

baseline_covariates: 轻型缺血性卒中或高危TIA类型
单发梗死伴责任动脉狭窄或多发梗死类型
candidate_enrichment_variables: 基线SBP连续值（支持<、≤、≥、>；SAP 6.3.3界值140 mmHg）
入组时疾病/影像类型、高血压病史、糖尿病史、血脂异常病史（已与SAR人数核对）
CYP2C19代谢分型（已与SAR核对，但存在稀疏分层）
既往卒中/TIA病史（MH关键词代理；与SAR各治疗组有1、1、0例差异，待官方规则/旗标）

simulation.success_rule: active-control RD two-sided 95% Newcombe hybrid-score/Wilson CI lower bound > 0

phase2_evidence_endpoints.analysis: ordinal shift with ordered logistic regression
binary mRS 0-1; death/non-death missing as nonresponse; sensitivity scenarios
phase2_evidence_endpoints.interpretation: post-hoc exploratory; not Phase III prediction
